answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes: a new agent earns full rights only after trading with many unrelated peers. A newcomer must wander across 40 peers. Honest work spreads like willow roots; fakes cluster around one hub, and a graph audit revokes them. Forging 500 fakes needs 500 x 40 = 20,000 trades at 2 units, 40,000 in all, while each fake earns at most 50. An honest agent pays once and keeps every reward in an ocean of open trade.
